Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game. So Netherlands have joined the big dance and will fly to Australia next year for the World Cup. They have booked their place in style. They can now focus to win this tournament and will now eye to roll over Ireland in the semifinal. For the United Arab Emirates, it was a day to forget but this is not the end of the road for them as they can still book a seat in the flight to Australia if they manage to win against Scotland. We are not done for the day as Namibia take on Oman later on. That game will begin at 1930 local (1530 GMT). Make sure you join us for that game. Till then, cheers!

Victorious Netherlands captain, Pieter Seelaar too, is surprised by the bounce and carry on the pitch but believes that it was one of the best exhibitions of fast bowling ever seen. But also adds that the best of Netherlands is yet to come. On the goals for future, Pieter says that the main goal was to qualify for the WT20 but next, their aim is to beat Ireland in the semi-final.

United Arab Emirates skipper, Ahmed Raza, says that he was surprised given the way the ball moved sideways. Admits that it is disappointing to have seen such inconsistent performances in the tournament but believes that they still have one more life left, so will concentrate on that game on Wednesday. On the message to his side, Raza says that they have been playing decent cricket and just need to lift themselves up. Congratulates Seelaar and the Netherlands.

BRANDON GLOVER HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. Says that the aim was to hit a hard length outside off and it worked. On the tactics, praises Pieter Seelaar for changing the bowlers so that the batsmen did not get used to one bowler but then also says that on such pitches, no bowler likes to be taken off. On the celebration to have qualified for the WT20, Glover says that the team is happy but the bowlers will have to plan on their bowling lengths in that country accordingly.

Earlier in the day, the Dutch bowlers set up the victory for their side, restricting the hosts to a paltry score of 80. Brandon Glover was the star with the ball ending up with a 4-fer. There was hardly anything to talk about UAE's batting as almost everyone struggled to read the pitch and threw their wickets away.

Defending 80 was always going to be impossible. The bowlers tried their best but there just wasn't enough runs on the board to fight with. Zahoor Khan and Rohan Mustafa had something to cheer about as they managed to get one wicket apiece.

Only an abysmal performance from the Dutch was going to see them falter chasing a paltry target of 81. Though they lost Max O'Dowd early, they never looked troubled.  Ben Cooper along with Colin Ackermann added a 51-run stand. The latter though departed but it was too late as Cooper and Ryan ten Doeschate ensured that there were no more casualties.
Netherlands have not just sealed their place in this tournaments semi-final, but they have also booked their ticket for next year's World Cup in Australia.

That is it! NETHERLANDS ARE THROUGH TO THE WT20 IN 2020 IN AUSTRALIA! For the 4th time in their history, have they qualified for the World T20. Down the leg side, Cooper tucks it towards fine leg and takes the single. Punches his fists in the air and smiles. They could not do it a couple of days ago but have done it here. VICTORY BY 8 WICKETS AND 29 BALLS TO SPARE!

Good length ball on off, Cooper looks to drive it but it goes off the inside half of his bat towards the bowler.

Darts one very full, almost a yorker. Ackermann does well to keep it out.

Defended off the back foot by the batsman. No run.

Pulled but not with conviction. Shorter on middle, Cooper pulls it but off the upper half of his bat. It goes wide of mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Good length ball on off, it is slightly overpitched. Cooper gets on his front foot and creams his drive wide of the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.

OUT! Bowled! The spinner strikes in his very first ball. The dangerous Max O'Dowd is out of here. UAE needed early wicket and they have got just that. Mustafa bowls it slower through the air on middle and off, O'Dowd looks to play it to  the off side but the ball goes right through the gate of his bat and body. It goes onto hit the top of middle. 76 runs needed.
Rohan Mustafa will bowl from the other end.

Appeal but nothing from the umpire. It is fuller on leg it swings in after pitching.  Cooper looks to play but gets beaten. The ball hits him on the front pad and rolls over to the off side. There is a stifled appeal but the umpire shakes it away. It looked to be going down leg.

Junaid starts with a beautiful delivery! Lovely swing on it. Wow! Full on off, it swings away. O'Dowd looks to drive it on the up but gets beaten.

We are back for the chase! Max O'Dowd and Ben Cooper make their way to the middle in pursuit of a target of 81. The UAE players are also making their way out to the middle. Junaid Siddique will start for the hosts.
